title: error@5
description: The one shape every refusal shares, the hub socket's refusals included; missing_field is a required field a call left out, carrying its tool's input schema, and not_ready a listing asked while the hub still loads its plug-ins, with what loaded and when to call again (#1415).

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

path.description: The JSON Pointer of the refused value.

actual.description: The value refused there, cut at the read cap on a code point. Scrubbing secrets from it is not done yet.

schema.x-opaque: a tool's input schema, as the tool list publishes it
schema.description: On missing_field: the input schema of the tool the call named, so the agent reads every field it takes.

loaded.description: On not_ready: the plug-ins loaded so far.

total.description: On not_ready: the plug-ins to load.

retry_after_ms.description: On not_ready: how long to wait before calling again, in milliseconds.
